source.cell_note: Source grid windows only; these are not extracted bounds or final atlas cells.

appearance_contract.body: Clearly adult, slender limbs and build, understated small bust.
garments: One ivory linen blouse tucked into the waistband
One opaque blue skirt with a functional walking slit
appearance_contract.continuity: Preserve braid attachment, compass side, skirt construction and body volume across every view. No trousers, shorts, leggings, waistcoat or second skirt layer.

observed_limitations: The top row repeats similar leading-leg contacts; four drawings do not prove four successive gait phases.
No complete alternating left/right walk loop is present.
Bottom-row directions are approximate static visual assignments, not an authored turn sequence.
Braid placement and accessory continuity need correction before animation admission.

intended_walk.phase_definition: Left and right mean the character's anatomical legs, never screen side. Contact labels apply independently at every facing.

phases.pose: Left heel contacts ahead; right toe finishes behind. Right arm leads.
Weight settles onto left leg; left knee bends; right foot leaves ground. Pelvis reaches low point.
Left leg supports; bent right leg passes beneath pelvis. Arms pass near neutral.
Left support heel rises; right leg swings ahead. Pelvis reaches high point.
Right heel contacts ahead; left toe finishes behind. Left arm leads; clearly opposite to phase zero.
Weight settles onto right leg; right knee bends; left foot leaves ground. Pelvis reaches low point.
Right leg supports; bent left leg passes beneath pelvis. Arms pass near neutral.
Right support heel rises; left leg swings ahead. Pelvis reaches high point and returns naturally into left contact.

intended_walk.loop_closure: Play phases 0 through 7 and then 0. Do not append a duplicated first frame or use ping-pong playback to substitute for missing opposite contacts.
drawing_requirements: Draw the entire character in each phase; retain fixed high three-quarter camera and consistent scale.
Keep a common ground anchor while allowing intentional pelvis bob; do not recenter each frame by bounding box.
Show planted-foot progression, opposite arm swing and skirt/braid follow-through without swapping garment construction.
Author each facing with correct overlap and compass side; mirroring an asymmetric character does not fulfill a new facing.
Preserve opaque hip and seat coverage throughout the single skirt's motion.

requirements: Provide distinct clockwise and counterclockwise whole-body transition poses between adjacent facings.
Use planted-foot pivot, intermediate torso orientation and settled destination pose, with stable ground registration.
Preserve current gait phase when transitioning between moving directional loops; a static facing sheet is not a turn animation.
